title: Beatrix and the Hollow
premise: Felix Okonkwo has spent his life in the Hollow, a fog-shrouded valley where magic cannot follow and stolen memories are the only currency worth having. When a dying courier named Beatrix presses a map into his hands and begs him to carry her secret — the location of the last true heir of the fallen royal line — Felix refuses, until the usurper's inquisitors burn the valley's edge and prove the Hollow is no longer safe. Fleeing with Beatrix's ghost-bound memory lodged in his own mind, Felix crosses into a world where his thefts mark him as both weapon and target. Hunted by the inquisitor Sable Vane, betrayed by the smugglers he hires, and slowly falling for the heir he was paid to deliver, Felix must choose between selling the secret that would buy his survival and telling the truth that could reignite an ancient war. In the end, he gives the memory back to Beatrix's restored body at the gates of the free cities, sacrificing his own past so the heir can be revealed — and discovers that what he stole first, long ago, was his own name.
about_author: Vesper Amberdale is the pen name of a former archivist who claims to have catalogued ten thousand letters never meant to be read. They write fantasy about people who carry other people's burdens, and live somewhere with unreliable weather.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. He steals a grief from a dying miller and trades it for bread, establishing the Hollow's memory economy and his own hollowed-out life. Emotional beat: quiet loneliness disguised as competence.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Threshold
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. A wounded woman collapses at the valley's only gate — impossible, since outsiders can't find it. She carries a sealed map and a wound that won't close. Emotional beat: unease; the world is leaking in.

chapters.title: What Beatrix Carried
chapters.summary: Beatrix's POV, fever-dream fragments. She reveals she guards a memory that isn't hers: the face and hiding place of the true heir. She asks Felix to hold it if she dies. Emotional beat: desperate trust offered to a stranger.

chapters.title: The Price of Holding
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Beatrix dies; against every instinct, Felix takes the memory into his own mind and feels another person's loyalty for the first time. The map burns itself into his palm. Emotional beat: reluctant inheritance.

chapters.title: Smoke on the Northern Ridge
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Inquisitors reach the valley's edge; magic begins to seep through cracks in the Hollow's warding. His neighbors turn on him, sensing the foreign memory. Emotional beat: exile from the only home he knew.

chapters.title: Out Into the Bright Country
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. He crosses the boundary and the world hits him — color, noise, and his own stolen memories stirring awake. He meets smuggler captain Odile Grey and barges passage for silence. Emotional beat: vertigo and wonder laced with fear.

chapters.title: The Thief Marked Twice
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. She recognizes the thief's brand on Felix's hand and the inquisitor's sigil now burned beside it — hunted by two worlds. She decides he's more valuable alive. Emotional beat: calculating mercy.

chapters.title: Sable Vane's Ledger
chapters.summary: Sable Vane's POV. The inquisitor interrogates a captured smuggler, revealing she once loved someone whose memories Felix's guild stole. Her hunt is personal. Emotional beat: cold purpose with a buried wound.

chapters.title: The City of Borrowed Faces
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. In the free city of Carrowgate, Felix pawns a minor memory for supplies and accidentally glimpses the heir's face in a stranger's dream-market. Someone else is shopping for the same secret. Emotional beat: paranoia blooming.

chapters.title: Odile's Bargain
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. She offers to take Felix to the heir's refuge — for the map. He refuses; she lets him believe she believes him. Emotional beat: trust extended on a knife's edge.

chapters.title: Memories of a War
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. The bound memory leaks: Felix experiences the ancient war from inside the heir's ancestor's eyes — the usurper's founding betrayal. He understands why the secret could reignite everything. Emotional beat: awe curdling into dread.

chapters.title: The Road Through Ashfall
chapters.summary: Felix and Odile's alternating POV. Ambushed by Vane's riders on the ash roads; Odile takes a wound shielding Felix without explaining why. Emotional beat: loyalty forming where neither wanted it.

chapters.title: What the Guild Took
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. In a guild safehouse, Felix finds records of his own childhood theft — his earliest memory was taken, and the missing piece is tied to the royal line. Emotional beat: the ground of self giving way.

chapters.title: Vane's Offer
chapters.summary: Sable Vane's POV. She corners Felix and offers him his stolen childhood back in exchange for the heir's location. For one night he genuinely considers it. Emotional beat: temptation rendered tender.

chapters.title: The Refuse
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. He reaches the heir's hidden refuge and finds it already sacked — but alive in its ruins is a young woman, Wren, who doesn't know what she is. Emotional beat: hope arriving broken.

chapters.title: Wren
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Raised ignorant of her blood, she must decide whether to accept Felix's proof — a memory she can feel beating inside him like a second heart. Emotional beat: terror of becoming significant.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Ford
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Cornered by Vane, Odile sells their route to save her crew — then turns on the inquisitors anyway and buys the others time with her ship and nearly her life. Emotional beat: treachery and sacrifice in the same breath.

chapters.title: The Weight of Two Truths
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Wren wants to reveal herself and save the free cities; Felix knows revelation means war. Their argument tears open his fear that truth is just another thing he'll lose. Emotional beat: love sharpened into conflict.

chapters.title: Vane Unmasked
chapters.summary: Sable Vane's POV. Felix shows Vane the leaked war-memory — including the face of the man she loved, erased by the usurper's own order. Her ledger breaks. Emotional beat: vengeance redirected.

chapters.title: The Gates of Carrowgate
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. With Vane's riders turned ally, they race the usurper's army to the free cities' council, carrying Wren and the living memory. Emotional beat: desperate momentum toward the light.

chapters.title: The Return of What Was Stolen
chapters.summary: Felix's POV, climax. Before the council, Felix performs the forbidden rite: he gives the memory back whole — and it takes his own stolen childhood with it, restoring Beatrix's spirit-witness and revealing Wren fully. The truth ignites not war but an uprising. Emotional beat: self-immolation as gift.

chapters.title: A Man With No Yesterday
chapters.summary: Felix's POV, resolution. Memoryless but free, Felix watches the free cities arm behind a rightful heir; Wren promises to help him steal himself back someday. He walks out the gate not fleeing, but choosing. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into beginning.
